description: This Java class 'ImmutableAcknowledgement' provides an immutable implementation of the 'Acknowledgement' interface, representing acknowledgements with labels, entity IDs, HTTP status codes, headers, and optional payloads. It includes methods for creating instances, accessing properties, converting to JSON, and equality checks.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgement
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Acknowledgement interface, representing an acknowledgement with label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutableAcknowledgement instance with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and payload.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the acknowledgement.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the acknowledgement.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Determines if the acknowledgement indicates success based on label and status code.

methods.name: isTimeout
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates a timeout.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the acknowledgement.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the payload entity as an Optional<JsonValue>.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new acknowledgement with the specified payload.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the acknowledgement.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new acknowledgement with the specified headers.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type of the entity ID.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the acknowledgement based on entity type.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the acknowledgement to a JsonObject, applying schema version and predicate filtering.
